# Rosalind Penrose

- **Age:** forty-five  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Rosalind Penrose is a tiny woman who never ages, maintaining a bright complexion reminiscent of a young girl with rosy cheeks, sweet lips, and dimples. Her hair is thick, wavy, lovely, and as white as snow, thoughtfully styled in flattering puffs and coils. She also features large, delightful, wood-brown eyes filled with tiny flecks of gold.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P6](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0006), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029)_

## History

Named by her father after the scent of lavender, Rosalind Penrose was considered a beauty in her youth and was once betrothed to [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md). However, a prideful quarrel ended their engagement twenty-five years ago, leading her to withdraw from social life into [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage), where she was largely forgotten. After [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde stumbled upon her solitary home, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) began visiting and eventually brought Stephen's son, [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), to meet her. Over time, as her health and spirits faltered, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) arranged a reunion by carrying a message from the newly arrived [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) to Rosalind. [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) visited [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) that evening, where the two embraced in the garden as lovers, leading to their garden wedding shortly after.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P16](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0016), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086), +23 more_

## Quotes

> “Cedric Stanhope?” Miss Rosalind’s tone shifted slightly. “What is his identity? I was under the impression that no person with that name resided in Brierley.”
>
> — Rosalind Penrose — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P81](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0081)

> "When you arrived here on that initial day, Nell, learning of Stephen’s boy startled me. Though I have been unable to bring him up to you from that moment on, I have longed to hear everything concerning him. How would you describe the boy?"
>
> — Rosalind Penrose — [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P21](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0021)

> "It makes me thoroughly embarrassed that an untested gown . . . even one made of forget-me-not organdy . . . can thrill me in this way, whereas a clean conscience plus an increased donation to Foreign Missions failed to accomplish it."
>
> — Rosalind Penrose — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P19](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0019)

> "For what I spent on them, those drapes ought to have lasted longer. Goodness, Belinda neglected to wipe down the banister once more. I am certainly going to have to address that with her."
>
> — Rosalind Penrose — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P58](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0058)

> "However, oh, will you not remain and partake of tea with me? I beg of you, do. The tea at Mr. Kimball’s will be finished prior to your arrival there. Furthermore, Belinda the Fourth and I shall be exceedingly happy to host you."
>
> — Rosalind Penrose — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--rosalind-penrose.md)

[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) first met Rosalind Penrose when she and a friend accidentally stumbled upon [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) while taking a wrong turn through the autumn woods. Their connection quickly blossomed into a close friendship, with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) spending a cozy winter night at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) listening to Rosalind confide the painful history of her long-ago engagement. Recognizing an opportunity to help her friend, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) arranged for Rosalind to meet her former lover's son, [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), and later facilitated a message that reunited Rosalind with her past love.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P16](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0016), +10 more_

- Friend of — close friends who visit each other  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P32](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0032), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P31](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0031)</sub>

### [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rosalind-penrose--stephen-stanhope.md)

Rosalind Penrose was previously engaged to [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md), but their original relationship ended due to a prideful misunderstanding that left her living a solitary life for many years. Decades later, [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) requested through [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to see Rosalind again, leading to an emotional reunion where the two embraced as lovers in the garden of [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage). Their rekindled romance culminated in marriage, with the couple celebrating their wedding in the garden before departing together by train.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P20](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0020), +12 more_
